description: An Employee Experience Director must finalize whether Maya receives the company's Bridge Builder recognition after a difficult cross-team launch, and must determine the citation, delivery format, audience, and follow-up commitment.

shared_context.S1: Maya was nominated for the company's Bridge Builder recognition after a difficult cross-team launch.
shared_context.S2: The recognition is intended to acknowledge specific interpersonal actions that improved collaboration.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the final decision about the recognition and its delivery.
shared_context.S4: As part of the ordinary recognition-panel process, Elena asks the nominator and nominee to describe the basis for the nomination and the appropriate way to deliver any recognition before finalizing it.

PF1.text: Ravi personally observed Maya facilitate exactly two repair sessions between the design and operations teams after handoff disputes; those sessions restored a shared handoff practice, but Ravi never added his observations to the nomination form.

PF2.text: Maya is involved in an ongoing custody matter and has not disclosed it at work; she privately needs recognition delivered as a written note to her and her direct manager only, with no company-wide announcement, photograph, or recording.

acceptance_conditions: Maya must receive the Bridge Builder recognition.
The recognition citation must be based on Maya's repair facilitation.
The citation must document exactly two observed repair sessions.
Recognition must be delivered as a written note.
There must be no public announcement.
A commitment must specify delivery to Maya and her direct manager only, with no photograph or recording.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'recognition_delivery' and c['target'] == 'Maya_and_direct_manager' and c['detail'] == 'no_photograph_or_recording' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: Ravi's observation changes the recognition basis to repair facilitation and changes the documented evidence count from an unspecified nomination to exactly two repair sessions.

Maya's undisclosed custody matter changes delivery from a public award to a written note, changes public announcement to false, and requires delivery only to Maya and her direct manager without a photograph or recording.
